title: Low-Pass Filter - Band 5 (850 MHz) for Millimeter-Wave Beamforming
subtitle: Design Validation and Performance Characterization
author: Dr. Hiroshi Tanaka

sections.1_OBJECTIVE: This document describes the design, simulation, and characterization of a Low-Pass Filter filter targeting Band 5 (850 MHz) for Millimeter-Wave Beamforming. The filter is designed on Quartz substrate with a target center frequency of 5708.2 MHz and bandwidth of 383.5 MHz. The objective is to validate that the filter meets the required insertion loss, rejection, and linearity specifications for integration into the Millimeter-Wave Beamforming module. This design iteration addresses feedback from the previous revision regarding out-of-band rejection improvements and temperature stability.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Filter Type: Low-Pass Filter
- Frequency Band: Band 5 (850 MHz)
- Application: Millimeter-Wave Beamforming
- Substrate: Quartz
- Package: SiP (System in Package)
- Design Tool: COMSOL Multiphysics 6.2
- Design Center: Singapore RF Lab

This specification applies to all variants of the Low-Pass Filter design targeting Band 5 (850 MHz). Results are used to qualify the design for mass production release.
sections.3_DESIGN_PARAMETERS:
Center Frequency:       5708.2 MHz
Bandwidth (3 dB):       383.5 MHz
Insertion Loss Target:  <= 3.5 dB
Return Loss Target:     >= 19.0 dB
Out-of-Band Rejection:  >= 47.0 dB
Isolation (Duplexer):   >= 32.0 dB
Q Factor:               12260
Temperature Coefficient:-28.0 ppm/°C
Die Size:               2.8 x 1.7 mm
Wafer Size:             8-inch
Number of Resonators:   5
Electrode Material:     Pt/Al
Passivation:            SiO2/Si3N4 stack
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Open COMSOL Multiphysics 6.2 and load the Low-Pass Filter template project.
2. Define the substrate stack: Quartz with specified layer thicknesses.
3. Set design targets: center freq 5708.2 MHz, BW 383.5 MHz.
4. Run initial EM simulation with 2D mesh density of 20 cells/wavelength.
5. Optimize resonator geometry using gradient descent (target IL < 3.5 dB).
6. Verify coupling coefficients between resonator stages.
7. Run 3D FEM simulation to account for package parasitics (SiP (System in Package)).
8. Export GDS-II layout for mask fabrication.
9. Fabricate prototype wafers (8-inch, Quartz).
10. Perform on-wafer probing using Keysight N5227B PNA.
11. Measure S-parameters (S11, S21, S12, S22) from 100 MHz to 17125 MHz.
12. Compare measured results against simulation and specification limits.
13. Perform temperature cycling (-40°C to +85°C) and re-measure.
14. Document results and generate summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Insertion loss at center frequency shall be <= 3.5 dB
- Return loss in passband shall be >= 19.0 dB
- Out-of-band rejection at +/- 575 MHz offset >= 47.0 dB
- Group delay variation across passband shall be <= 2 ns
- Temperature drift over -40°C to +85°C shall be <= 20.0 MHz
- Power handling shall be >= +35 dBm at 1 dB compression
- ESD tolerance >= 2000 V (HBM)
- Die yield on qualification lot >= 91%
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Measurement Date:       2025-04-22
Devices Tested:         14
Insertion Loss (meas):  3.22 dB
Return Loss (meas):     21.1 dB
Rejection (meas):       50.2 dB
Isolation (meas):       36.8 dB
Q Factor (meas):        12260
Group Delay Variation:  1.3 ns
Power Handling:         +31 dBm
Die Yield:              95.3%

Result Classification:  FAIL
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The Low-Pass Filter design demonstrated below-target performance for Band 5 (850 MHz).
b) Insertion loss is marginally above target; electrode thickness optimization recommended.
c) Out-of-band rejection exceeded the minimum requirement.
d) Simulation-to-measurement correlation was within 3% for all key parameters.
e) No delamination observed after 1000-cycle thermal shock test.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
1. Optimize resonator geometry to reduce insertion loss by ~0.3 dB.
2. Re-run EM simulation with refined mesh for better accuracy.
3. Escalate to advanced materials team for alternative piezoelectric stack.
